tmp.text: Greven il-Vec abandons his people to join the Stronghold's oppressors, becoming il-Vec and rising to command the skyship Predator.

Volrath orders him to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard, and Predator ambushes the ship and overpowers its crew, with Greven capturing Gerrard and then throwing Vhati overboard after Vhati's attempt to assassinate him.

When Volrath vanishes and the Stronghold falls into chaos, Greven takes charge but is laid low in a fight with Crovax, and he turns down Belbe's offer to be considered for evincar, preferring to be the sword rather than the hand.
Predator finally intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg, where Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.

sth.text: In Stronghold, Greven il-Vec captures Ertai and takes him to the Stronghold, and later Crovax defeats him.

exo.text: In Exodus, Greven il-Vec threatens to flay Gerrard, but Gerrard bests him only by sacrificing any semblance of defense.
Flowstone lunges at the Weatherlight as though it has taken on Greven's rage.

nem.text: In Nemesis, Volrath confronts Greven il-Vec and claims him, saying "you, Greven, are mine."
As the evincar succession contest unfolds, Greven prefers servitude, and Belbe shortlists him with Crovax and Ertai but prefers Ertai.
